Method of Attack: Authenticated database reset vulnerability caused by lack of authorization and nonce token check allowing any authenticated user including low-privileged users to delete all tables in the database with the prefix wp
Exploitation requires passing a query parameter like '%%wp' to delete all tables
Allows attacker to trigger WordPress installation process and create administrator account
Impacted Systems: Premium versions of WP Reset plugin up to 5.98
WordPress sites using WP Reset PRO plugin
Attack Vector: Authenticated user with any role including low-privileged users such as subscribers exploiting lack of authorization and nonce token check
